title: A Short Conversation
text:
Hi! My name is Ana. Hello, Ana! I am Tom. Nice to meet you.

Ana asks, "How are you?" Tom says, "I am good, thanks." Then they say goodbye. Ana says, "Goodbye, Tom!"

questions.text: What is the name of the girl?
What does Tom say when Ana asks how he is?
How do Ana and Tom probably feel when they meet?
Why do Ana and Tom say goodbye at the end?

vocabulary.definition: a word you say when you meet someone
words you say to show you are grateful
a word you say when you leave someone

paragraph_translations: Oi! Meu nome é Ana. Olá, Ana! Eu sou o Tom. Prazer em conhecê-la.
Ana pergunta: "Como você está?" Tom responde: "Estou bem, obrigado." Depois eles se despedem. Ana diz: "Tchau, Tom!"
